ops.title: imsg-bridge NAC blocker: rustpush validation-data needs closed-source open-absinthe
ops.body: rustpush's MacOSConfig::generate_validation_data() (called on EVERY IDS register + every auto re-registration, ~per 15-min NAC TTL) delegates to open-absinthe's ValidationCtx (nac new/key_establishment/sign). The PUBLIC OpenAbsinthe-Stub + clearadi-stub ship todo!()/panic bodies; functional impls are closed-source (SSPL exception + proprietary, OpenBubbles-only). => imsg-bridge compiles against public submodules but PANICS at register. Native macOS AOSKit/nac_sign is NOT a drop-in: it signs the RUNNING machine identity = the metal VM's VirtualMac2,1 (the documented ban vector); injecting a harvested physical-host HardwareConfig requires the closed clearadi (X-Apple-I-MLB/ROM/SRL-NO) + open-absinthe. Options being weighed: (A) host-side native-NAC oracle signing the genuine physical host identity per renewal (no closed crates, needs a Tahoe-capable native helper; beeper/mac-registration-provider is archived+Sonoma-capped); (B) reassess vs Corten/lrhodin-imessage (a LIVE headless rustpush->Matrix bridge that already solved this) => F' path; (C) obtain OpenBubbles' closed crates; (D) stay-and-harden 2 VMs. Full rustpush impl spec: scratchpad/imsg-bridge-spec.md. rustpush pinned commit 70ec162c6838830194d55792c8b26e4d6681c816.
